get.summary: Find movies on TMDB
get.description: With a query, TMDB’s search; without one, a list for the server’s region: `trending` (this week, the default), `popular`, `now-playing` or `upcoming`. Library movies are marked `inLibrary`. Answers 503 with `details.reason` `no-tmdb-key` or `tmdb-unreachable`, or 429 with `tmdb-rate-limited`.

get.summary: Everything TMDB knows about a movie, in the library or not
get.description: By TMDB id, for any movie on TMDB: from the cache, or from TMDB when the server hasn’t seen it. Nothing is added to the library. Answers 503 with `details.reason` `no-tmdb-key` or `tmdb-unreachable`, or 429 with `tmdb-rate-limited`, when the cache can’t answer and TMDB is needed.

get.summary: More like this
get.description: TMDB’s recommendations, or its “similar” list when those are empty (checkpoint 4, decision 6). At most 20. Answers 503 with `details.reason` `no-tmdb-key` or `tmdb-unreachable`, or 429 with `tmdb-rate-limited`, when the cache can’t answer and TMDB is needed.

get.summary: A collection and its parts
get.description: By TMDB id. Each part says whether it’s in the library. Answers 503 with `details.reason` `no-tmdb-key` or `tmdb-unreachable`, or 429 with `tmdb-rate-limited`, when the cache can’t answer and TMDB is needed.

get.summary: A person and their filmography
get.description: By TMDB id. Each credit says whether its movie is in the library. Answers 503 with `details.reason` `no-tmdb-key` or `tmdb-unreachable`, or 429 with `tmdb-rate-limited`, when the cache can’t answer and TMDB is needed.

get.summary: A poster, backdrop, photo or logo from the image cache
get.description: Art URLs in every response point here. Served with `Cache-Control: private, max-age=31536000, immutable` and an ETag: TMDB gives a changed image a new file name. Fetched from TMDB the first time; apps send their token with image requests as with any other. 404 for an owner, kind, size or file the server doesn’t serve.

get.summary: Metadata: whether a TMDB key is set, the language and the region

put.summary: Save the TMDB key, the metadata language or the region
put.description: A new key is checked with TMDB first: 400 with `details.reason` `tmdb-key-rejected` when TMDB doesn’t accept it, 503 (`tmdb-unreachable`) when TMDB can’t be reached. Nothing is saved unless every field is. The key is stored encrypted and never returned.

delete.description: The library and its pages keep working from the cache.

post.description: The key step’s Continue. 400 with `details.reason` `tmdb-key-rejected` when TMDB doesn’t accept it; 503 (`tmdb-unreachable`) when TMDB can’t be reached.

For people who may ask for titles, a `discover` section adds TMDB’s matches that aren’t here, to request; it’s left out when TMDB can’t be reached, and for everyone until requests arrive.
